Only 16 sites are priced by the night: 20-25, 35-37 and 39-45. The operator's map marks most of the rest (numbered to 72) as seasonal.

note: On Lake Sebasticook in Newport; an RV park only, no tent sites, with six lakeshore cabins, most sites held by seasonals. --Claude
summary: Fees $40-45, water and sewer, showers confirmed; added store, wifi, the nightly-site list. Note cleaned. Seasonal flag below is the main finding.
flags: SEASONAL: MOSTLY SEASONAL on the operator's own evidence. Its campground map marks most sites with the 'Seasonal Sites' square; only sites 20-25, 39-45 (water/electric) and 35-37 (full) are shown and priced as nightly, 16 of a numbering that runs to 72, about 22%. A Google review a year ago: 'We got a spot for 2 nights right on the water ... There are a lot of seasonal campers but the sites were all very well kept'. Another, 3 years ago: 'We have stayed here many times'. The operator leads with RV travelers ('traveling by R.V.') and sells nights, so the five tests aren't all failed; it's the mostly-seasonal call and AWH's rule on a borderline one.

PRIVATE GATE FACTS: posted rate $40 base, no year on the page; the map's older prices are lower. Under $50. Good Sam: gs false, military true, by name in the cached directory; gsr.py's live lookup matched a different park, so no Good Sam score. No gateway within 40 km (Acadia NP 91 km), not needed. Presence: own site, phone (207) 368-4645, Google 'Christies Campground' 4.6 on 102 reviews. RV Life 4.0. No booking engine.

WATERFRONT lakefront stands for nightly sites. Map shows sites 20-25 in the row against the Lake Sebasticook shore, with the loop road behind them. Reviews: 'a spot next to the lake which offered stunning views' (6 months ago), 'right on the water' (a year ago). Imagery shows the lake edge with scattered trees; I can't pick out each pad. The 39-45 and 35-37 sites stand back from the shore, so the $45 sites aren't lakefront.

BOOKING: no reservation page or policy; phone only, and I left booking unwritten. Season: operator states none ('~May-late Nov' came from the old note), cabins' page speaks of May-October, so season stays as stored and the note's dates are dropped.
UNVERIFIED: laundry (true, derived) isn't on the operator's pages I read; left as stored. Boat launch and docks in the old note weren't verified, so they left the note. Amperage not stated.
PIN fine: stored point is on the campground road amid the sites. ADDRESS: operator's site says 83 Christies Campground Rd, Google 86.
